follow-up time: Neonatal period (up to 28 days after birth)
cohort: 850 newborns admitted to the neonatal unit of the Yaounde Gynaeco-Obstetric and Pediatric Hospital in Cameroon between March 2003 and December 2012
finding: Prolonged membrane rupture, low birth weight, Apgar score less than 7 at 5 minutes, and congenital malformations were significant risk factors for neonatal mortality, while cesarean delivery and being born in the hospital were protective.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was associated with a lower risk of neonatal mortality.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was a significant risk factor for neonatal mortality.
